channel.title: Pier & Point · P7
channel.description: Changes, corrections and dated milestones for P7 (Mission Bay), San Francisco. Every item names its source.

item.title: Correction · P7: Recreation and Parks' estimated schedule (page undated) gives construction beginning late 2028 and opening to the public early 2030; the same page says the remaining parks are anticipated to be complete by 2028. All are expected dates.

item.title: Correction · P7: The notes said no named, funded project had been found for P7. SF Rec & Park's Mission Bay Future Parks Project page names P7 and P9 as future active-recreation parks (skate park, pickleball courts, ballfield) fully funded through OCII, with construction to begin in late 2028, so that caveat was replaced and the page is now cited for the planned status and park use. The 'construction staging materials' description is now labelled an imagery observation, and an out-of-date note saying the neighbouring P8 record had been removed was corrected.
item.description: The notes said no named, funded project had been found for P7. SF Rec & Park's Mission Bay Future Parks Project page names P7 and P9 as future active-recreation parks (skate park, pickleball courts, ballfield) fully funded through OCII, with construction to begin in late 2028, so that caveat was replaced and the page is now cited for the planned status and park use. The 'construction staging materials' description is now labelled an imagery observation, and an out-of-date note saying the neighbouring P8 record had been removed was corrected. Source: SF Recreation and Park Department, Mission Bay Future Parks Project (https://sfrecpark.org/1832/Mission-Bay-Future-Parks-Project).

item.title: Milestone · P7: Design-team selection process under way: per Rec and Park's August 2025 update, the developer (Mission Bay Development Group) released a request for qualifications in early August 2025 and expected to select a design team by mid-October (Aug 2025)
